universe.scope: Point-in-time classified US ordinary operating companies in the active catalogue; current membership feasibility only. Historical membership including delistings is required before evaluation.
universe.identity: Durable security_id and effective-dated listing, issuer CIK and corporate-action lineage. CIK identifies issuer, not share class; ticker is never the durable join key.
exclusions: banks and insurers pending separate accounting contract
REITs and BDCs pending separate comparability contract
foreign issuers and ADRs outside this US ordinary-company scope
universe.sample_policy: Do not choose a family threshold to maximize coverage. No sample minimum or historical start is approved.

schedule.draft: Monthly final completed US exchange session, decision_at at 23:59 UTC; exchange calendar and timestamp convention require review.
schedule.entry: Next regular-session open after decision_at; no same-close execution.
schedule.timezone: All timestamps timezone-aware, normalized UTC; holidays and early closes use exchange calendar.

availability.rule: public_at and retrieved_at required; available_at=max(public_at,retrieved_at); all <= decision_at. Equality is included. Missing timestamps fail closed.
availability.revisions: Only revisions eligible at decision_at under existing canonical-liquidity resolver and contract hash. Restatements never rewrite past decisions.
availability.classification: Effective-dated classification and issuer/listing mappings must be visible at decision_at. Current membership cannot establish historical membership.

factors.name: free_cash_flow_yield
factors.rationale: Relates owner cash generation to the price paid.
factors.numerator: TTM operating cash flow minus TTM capital expenditure
factors.currency_unit: same currency; numerator and denominator monetary
factors.negative_treatment: retain signed value for research; withhold ranking
factors.denominator_guard: strictly positive and above configured materiality floor
factors.sector_limitations: financial companies require separate comparability review

factors.name: return_on_assets
factors.rationale: Measures earnings generated per unit of assets.
factors.negative_treatment: negative is valid but not converted to a score in this draft
factors.denominator_guard: positive average assets above materiality floor
factors.sector_limitations: industry balance sheets may not be comparable

factors.name: net_debt_to_operating_cash_flow
factors.rationale: Tests debt burden against internally generated cash.
factors.numerator: current debt plus non-current debt minus cash
factors.negative_treatment: net cash is retained; non-positive cash flow withholds ratio

factors.name: revenue_growth
factors.numerator: current TTM revenue minus prior TTM revenue
factors.currency_unit: same reporting currency and USD monetary unit

factors.name: diluted_share_growth
factors.rationale: Identifies dilution or contraction in owners' claim count.
factors.numerator: current diluted shares minus prior comparable diluted shares
factors.negative_treatment: buybacks may yield negative values; retain signed value

factors.name: total_return_volatility
factors.rationale: Describes variability of shareholder total returns.
factors.numerator: annualised standard deviation of split-adjusted daily total returns
factors.staleness: latest completed session within seven calendar days
factors.sector_limitations: none; security actions can make series incomparable

contracts.B: Leverage and liquidity mandatory, coverage optional
contracts.D: Explicit zero-debt branch or leveraged branch with leverage and coverage

review: Debt composition and overlap; commercial paper, convertibles and lease inclusion
Gross interest versus net interest; defensible EBIT bridge, never pre-tax income alone
Same reporting periods, currency and duration; no latest-field mixing
Explicit debt-free evidence and applicability; missing is never zero
Financial-sector comparability; independent components cannot be redundant
financial_strength.audit_policy: Reuse Milestone 40 counterfactual contracts for evidence feasibility, not validated factor calculations. Existing audit EBIT and period alignment limitations remain blockers.

contract_tradeoffs.A: Preserves all-component coverage; absent gross interest/defensible EBIT blocks leveraged companies. Applicability policy still requires review.
contract_tradeoffs.B: Omitting coverage and cash-generation requirements changes the economic hypothesis; leverage and current ratio cannot certify debt-service capacity.
contract_tradeoffs.C: Two ready components can omit coverage and debt service; establish economic independence and comparability before approval.
contract_tradeoffs.D: Explicit zero debt must include the approved debt and lease perimeter; missing interest or debt never establishes the zero-debt branch. Leveraged coverage still needs defensible EBIT.

history.accounting: Four comparable quarters for TTM; five quarters for ROA beginning/ending assets; eight non-overlapping quarters for growth; two comparable annual share durations. No mixing annual/YTD/quarter duration or double-counting.
history.prices: 253 completed sessions for 252 daily returns; exact horizon sessions plus entry/exit and complete corporate actions.
history.staleness: Accounting filing <=180 calendar days; last completed price session <=7 calendar days. Thresholds and materiality floors require review.
history.assessment_limit: Single-boundary field readiness is an input proxy, not proof of TTM, aligned periods, history, identity continuity or completed outcomes.

missingness.policy: Never impute missing debt, interest, cash, dividends or returns to zero. Explicit not_applicable requires evidence under approved contract. Retain signed numerators and distress flags; withhold invalid denominators.
missingness.bins: Exact count of full families, 0 through 6, over complete comparable denominator; cumulative thresholds separately labelled.
missingness.exclusions: Report exclusion and missingness counts before samples; no return-driven removal or complete-case threshold selection.

outcomes.primary: 252-session benchmark-relative net total return; 126 secondary, subject to preregistration review.
outcomes.benchmark: Predeclare investable broad US total-return benchmark, currency, source, version and calendar. No benchmark chosen from observed performance.
outcomes.requirements: Split/action adjusted entry and exit prices, dividends with declared reinvestment convention, mergers, spinoffs, delisting proceeds and benchmark total returns. No price-only substitution or silent dropping of failed securities.
outcomes.completeness: Incomplete horizons withheld and counted; outcome tables not read in this assessment.

costs.policy: Reuse CostAssumptions validator. Combined 50 bps at turnover=1 is illustrative, not approved round-trip economics. Review half/full spread, per-side commissions, USD FX applicability, impact, participation, entry/exit turnover and capacity. Missing observed spread cannot establish execution feasibility. No sensitivity tuning against returns.

evaluation.splits: Chronological development, specification-lock review, then untouched final holdout; exact dates and minimum cross-sectional/time sample sizes unresolved.
evaluation.purge: Remove observations whose outcome windows cross split boundaries; embargo at least maximum 252-session horizon. Group share classes by issuer when estimating dependence.
controls: Freeze universe, definitions, costs, benchmark, horizons, exclusions and multiplicity policy before outcome access
No use of future filings, revised membership, aliases or corporate actions in features
Separate outcome-only future actions from point-in-time features
Predeclare dependence-aware intervals and multiplicity for six families/two horizons; no performance-based contract selection
Untouched holdout access ledger and prospective registration timestamp required
evaluation.execution: No backtest, model execution, panel persistence or return tuning authorized.

provenance.policy: Aggregate read-only assessment only; no panel rows are persisted.
